title: lebre: online forecasting with statistically tested structural changes
description:
Installable Python library implementing LEBRE v0.52-r1, an online one-step-ahead forecaster for a target driven by exogenous inputs, at a cost of a few hundred floating-point operations per step. Structural changes (adding, removing or swapping a whole input, or refining its lag response) are accepted only when an anytime-valid e-process of predictive improvement crosses a level set by an online multiple-testing rule.

The library implements the frozen research version documented and evaluated in the research record (doi:10.5281/zenodo.23049103). In the reference environment (Windows, CPython 3.11, NumPy 2.2.5) its forecasts are bit-for-bit identical to the frozen research code; on other platforms they agree up to floating-point rounding, with identical structural decisions in the regression tests.

Scope and limits. The evaluation covers hydrology and building-energy series with 1-5 inputs and one-step forecasting; the pre-declared cost contract was narrowly missed; the testing mechanism did not improve accuracy over switching all inputs on. See the research record for the full evidence and its limits.
